feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 3:59pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

The rain will move away early this evening, leaving dry conditions for the rest of the evening and overnight as clear spells soon develop. The strong winds will ease too during the evening, then becoming light overnight, the minimum temperature tonight 6°C.

A fine day tomorrow, with good sunny spells and mainly light winds. Maximum temperature 12°C, then tomorrow night heavy rain will arrive as winds become stronger.


##Outlook##

Heavy rain at first on Friday, with a risk of localised flooding, but gradually clearing through the afternoon. Strong northwest winds, touching gale force in places for a time.

Then an unsettled weekend, with gales or severe gales causing travel disruption.
